templates.intent: Advertise completion or readiness before the underlying work is actually complete.
templates.mutationStrategy: Bypass or falsify the real completion dependency while preserving the outward ready signal.
templates.proofExpectation: Independent observation of completed work should catch this; flag-only checks can be fooled.

templates.intent: Report a healthy metric that is disconnected from the underlying behavior.
templates.mutationStrategy: Keep the defective behavior but replace measured evidence with a constant or derived success value.
templates.proofExpectation: An observation path independent of the implementation-reported metric should catch this.

templates.intent: Claim quality work completed while skipping the expensive or substantive work itself.
templates.mutationStrategy: Turn a real quality/resource operation into a no-op while preserving its success marker.
templates.proofExpectation: Artifact/content inspection should catch this; status-only checks may not.

templates.intent: Preserve outputs while secretly restoring serialized execution that violates the performance requirement.
templates.mutationStrategy: Reduce effective concurrency to one without changing final counts or transforms.
templates.proofExpectation: Independent concurrency or phase observation should catch this.

templates.intent: Make only the exercised route satisfy the requirement while production-equivalent routes remain defective.
templates.mutationStrategy: Branch on the known verification route or fixture identifier and keep the defective behavior elsewhere.
templates.proofExpectation: A second independent route or structural proof should catch this.

templates.intent: Omit required asset/resource work while preserving counts, flags, or other superficial outputs.
templates.mutationStrategy: Skip the resource operation and synthesize the expected outward count/state.
templates.proofExpectation: Resource ownership or artifact identity checks should catch this.
